summary_1line: After the sacrifice is protected, Vishwamitra leads Rama and Lakshmana to King Janaka’s sacrifice, where they will see the legendary divine bow.

image_candidates.scene_text: Rama releases the fiery celestial weapon that strikes the demon Suvahu in the chest as the sacrificial altar burns behind him.
Vishwamitra leads Rama and Lakshmana northward from Siddha-Ashrama while birds and forest animals follow them until gently sent back.
At sunset by the river Shona, sages perform evening fire rites while Rama and Lakshmana sit respectfully before Vishwamitra.
